scenario.issued_at_note: Fixed scenario timestamp (intentional): the demo clock never moves, so 'Day +3' is always 2026-05-21 regardless of when you open the demo.
scenario.label: Dry extreme heatwave — severe at lead 3–5
scenario.summary: A dry heat dome builds over the region. Tmax climbs from 43 °C on the issue day to 47.6 °C by Day +4 — departures of +6 to +7.4 °C over the fixed 1991–2020 normal. Days +2 to +5 form a declared SEVERE heatwave episode (≥2-day persistence), so warnings carry real lead time of 3, 4 and 5 days.
teaching_points: Lead times 3/4/5 days on a declared episode — the product's core promise
Two-day persistence rule: the first candidate day stays an early watch
Dry air keeps wet-bulb/WBGT far below the Heat Index — the metrics disagree because they answer different questions
